tenants.title: Companies
tenants.description: Every tenant on the platform, their plan, subscription and recent activity.
tenants.suspendDescription: This immediately blocks every user of "{name}" from signing in. State otherwise unaffected.
tenants.reactivateDescription: This restores access for every user of "{name}".
tenants.supportAccessDescription: Records an audited "tenant.accessed" event for "{name}" before you view or act inside it.
tenants.supportAccessReasonHint: Required. Describe the support request this access is for.
tenants.supportAccessGranted: Support access recorded. Use the tenant switcher to view this tenant for up to {minutes} minutes.
tenants.subtitle: Who uses Goliath, on what plan, and since when.
tenants.name: Company

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: SaaS plans available to tenants at signup and for support-assisted changes.
plans.subtitle: What is on sale, and who is on it.
plans.name: Name
plans.codeLocked: The code cannot be changed: the public sign-up form sends it and Stripe points at it.
plans.priceNote: Changing a price does not change what current subscribers pay.
plans.readOnly: You can look at the plans but not change them.

health.title: Platform health
health.description: Background job throughput, webhook processing and storage usage across every tenant.
health.schedulerDescription: When each task the application runs on its own last ran.
health.neverRanExplanation: This task has never run. Almost always that means the scheduler cron line is missing on the server. Without it this file never runs and nothing else says so.
health.cronLine: In Forge, tick the scheduler on the Scheduler tab, or add this cron line by hand:
health.providersDescription: What is bound to each interface in this installation. Read from the container when this page opens, not from a table — a table could say "connected" with the environment variable already gone.
health.expirationsDescription: Warnings materialised by the sweep, not yet resolved.
health.expirationsOldest: The oldest was first detected on {date}
health.expirationsEmpty: No pending expirations — or the sweep has not run.

consequence.notificationsSweep: Without it, no alerts go out for expiring documents, carriers due for reverification, or overdue invoices.
consequence.retentionSweep: Without it, nothing is archived or purged: expired records pile up indefinitely and the retention policy the company has configured is not being applied.

errors.notSuspended: This tenant is not currently suspended.

show.title: Company
show.usageHint: Enforcement is decided company by company, below. Turning it on for one that is already over cuts off its new records straight away, so it is not allowed: talk to the customer first, put up the wall after.
show.suspendWarning: Suspending locks everyone in this company out of the app immediately. Their data stays untouched.
show.reasonHint: Required, and kept forever in the audit trail. In six months this will be the only record of why.
show.billingNote: Billing is not connected yet. The Stripe identifiers are stored and shown here; charging runs through its own integration.

suspended.title: This company is suspended
suspended.body: Nobody in this company can use the app while it is suspended. Nothing has been deleted: the data is intact and comes back as soon as it is reactivated.
suspended.contact: Get in touch with Goliath Dispatch to sort it out.

limits.refusedOver: Enforcement cannot be turned on: this company is already over {resources}. Talk to the customer and make room before putting up the wall.
limits.enforced: Plan limits are now enforced for this company.
limits.relaxed: Plan limits are no longer enforced: they are still counted and block nothing.
limits.title: Plan limits
limits.notEnforced: Limits are counted and block nothing.
